mcq_fix.s: The 600 MW SAEL solar project in Kadapa was the first project commissioned under which Andhra Pradesh policy?

patterns: APPSC asks location identification: largest solar park in India (Bhadla, 2023), Shakti Sthala = Pavagada (Karnataka), 25 MW floating solar at Simhadri.
AP-specific traps: Kurnool UMSP at Gani-Sakunala, Talaricheruvu (UMSP-II), Ramagiri (hybrid) - don't mix places.
Definition trap: Ultra Mega Solar Park = 500 MW+, not 1,000 MW.
App adds scheme data (PM Surya Ghar, PM-KUSUM, ICEP-2024 projects) at current-affairs depth; PYQs stay at 'which place / largest' level.
